stories.headline: BTC pushes higher into the mid-$86ks
stories.blurb: Up ~3.6% week-over-week and ~8.4% month-over-month — still a modest move, so the structure read stays Neutral.
stories.why_matters: The 7-day bull trigger ($85k) is now in play, so the 7D outlook tilts slightly toward Bull.

stories.headline: The move is spot-led: leverage keeps leaving
stories.blurb: CheckOnChain: futures open interest down ~1.6% WoW while price rose ~2.3% (Spot Rally quadrant).
stories.why_matters: Rallies without leverage chasing are sturdier and less prone to sharp liquidation flushes.

stories.headline: RSDH stays SOL-heavy BULL, but its edge over BTC is gone
stories.blurb: Fresh Oct-5 bar: SOL 95% / BTC 5% / cash 0%, macro BULL; Final× now level with buy-and-hold BTC.
stories.why_matters: BTC led this week's move, so the SOL tilt stopped adding value — watch whether SOL catches up.

stories.headline: Fed liquidity still deteriorating until Thursday's print
stories.blurb: Latest weekly H.4.1 is Wed 09-30 (Contracting); next release Thu 10-08. Daily Treasury cash data still as-of Oct 1.
stories.why_matters: The rally is running against a liquidity headwind — a second contracting week would raise the bar for follow-through.

stories.headline: On-chain cycle still Bearish (carry-over from Oct 1)
stories.blurb: BlockHorizon Cycle 34 Bearish with weak breadth (6/16), though 30-day momentum is rising across signals; not re-scraped on Monday's short edition.
stories.why_matters: On-chain hasn't confirmed the price push yet; Tuesday's deep edition re-checks it.
